scholarship.title: The Scholarship
scholarship.description: Purpose, benefits, exam structure, and important dates of the program.

purpose.heading: Why this program exists
purpose.body: Too much potential goes unnoticed simply because opportunity is unevenly distributed. The ScholarSphere Excellence Scholarship looks for that potential early — in Grades 4 through 10 — and gives it a stage, a fair examination, and real recognition. One application and one rigorous exam are all it takes to be seen.

items.title: Recognition
items.body: A published merit list and a certificate that honors achievement in front of family, school, and community.

items.title: Financial support
items.body: One-time awards from ৳5,000 to ৳20,000 (fictional amounts) to ease the cost of studies.

items.title: Mentorship & resources
items.body: Selected scholars join study circles and receive guidance materials through the program year.

items.title: A fair chance
items.body: Selection depends only on the entrance examination — not connections, backgrounds, or ability to pay beyond the modest fee.

exam.heading: Exam structure at a glance
exam.body: Every grade sits a written examination designed for its level. The structure below is the 2026 configuration; full details live on the Eligibility page.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.body: Fill in the seven-step application wizard — student, guardian, and academic details.

steps.title: Pay the fee
steps.body: Send the grade-based fee through DemoPay and enter the transaction ID (simulated payment).

steps.title: Sit the exam
steps.body: Download your admit card in December and take the entrance examination on exam day.

steps.title: Results & awards
steps.body: Merit lists are published in January; awards follow at a ceremony in February.

payment.heading: Paying the application fee
payment.body: Payment runs through DemoPay, a fictional mobile financial service included purely for the learning experience. No real money moves anywhere — verification is simulated.

cta.title: Ready to begin?
cta.body: The application takes about 20 minutes. Your draft is saved as you go, so you can finish it later.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.description: Who can apply for Grades 4–10, subject requirements, and exam rules.

general.heading: Before you check your grade
items: The student must be enrolled in the grade applied for, in the 2026 academic year.
The institution must be recognized by the relevant education board or authority.
Grades 6 and above require the minimum annual-exam GPA listed for that grade.
One application per student per cycle — duplicate submissions are rejected.

eligibility.feeNote: The application fee is ৳100–200 depending on grade, paid through the fictional DemoPay service during registration.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How this demo handles data — locally, in your browser.
privacy.intro: This is a learning project, not a real scholarship program. This policy explains honestly what happens to anything you type here.

sections.heading: No real data collection
paragraphs: ScholarSphere has no backend server. Every page you see runs in your browser, and every request is answered by a simulated API in memory.
We do not collect, transmit, or sell personal information. There are no analytics, no tracking pixels, and no third-party services receiving your data.

sections.heading: What is stored, and where
paragraphs: Application drafts, submitted (demo) applications, and contact-form messages are stored in your browser's localStorage under a namespaced key.
This storage is confined to your browser and your device. Clearing your browser's site data removes it permanently.

sections.heading: Fictional content
paragraphs: Names, schools, statistics, dates, and payment providers shown across the site are fictional and exist only to make the demonstration realistic.
Any resemblance to real people or institutions is coincidental.

sections.heading: Your control
paragraphs: Because everything is local, you hold every control: clear site data to erase all demo records, or use the admin dashboard's reset action to restore the pristine seed state.

sections.heading: Questions
paragraphs: For anything about this demo project, use the contact page — messages stay in your browser's demo inbox.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern the fictional ScholarSphere Excellence Scholarship demonstration. By using this site you acknowledge its demo nature.

sections.heading: A demonstration, not an offer
paragraphs: No real scholarship, award, or payment is offered or implied. The program, its office, its staff, and its payment service (DemoPay) are fictional.
Nothing you submit here creates a legal relationship or an entitlement.

sections.heading: Eligibility rules
paragraphs: Within the demo, eligibility follows the published grade-wise requirements on the Eligibility page: enrollment in the applied grade, a recognized institution, and the minimum annual-exam GPA where applicable.
One application per student per cycle is accepted.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Please do not submit abusive, misleading, or automated bulk content through the demo forms.
Demo data may be reset or cleared at any time without notice — do not store anything you care about in this application.

sections.heading: Content and intellectual property
paragraphs: The site's design, code, and written content are part of the learning project. Fictional names and stories are invented for the demonstration and are not real endorsements.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: These terms may change as the project evolves. The current version is always the one published on this page.
